fieldData.description:
To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your fellow Indonesia community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT!
This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks for everyone.
Feel free to reach out to @snoozledoo on Telegram for any clarification and join Indonesia community https://t.me/radix_indonesia
fieldData.location: Jl. Ciumbuleuit No.130 130 Jalan Ciumbuleuit Kec. Cidadap, Jawa Barat 40141 Indonesia
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Indonesia
